title: ThonRetire Retirement Index 2026
description:
ThonRetire Retirement Index 2026 — a sealed edition of the ThonRetire retirement destination dataset.

17 destinations, 39 criteria, 6 ranking axes. Every figure carries the month it was last checked against the issuing authority's own page, and a figure past twice its refresh interval is withheld rather than shown stale.

This edition is frozen. The live site keeps moving; this file does not. Its sha256 is 45f2266f7801ff60ec5760b90369d5c8010e0a2687cb6c34a34e449622f68f13, computed over the edition file itself, so anyone citing it can prove the numbers they cited are the numbers that were published.

Landing page: https://thonretire.com/edition/2026
